title: Onchain Game
tagline: I figured out how to mint within a browser-based game UI across 7 blockchains, using nouns artwork.
description: What are video games other than really really good UI? This was an experiment to see how we could improve minting experience, but also other things like governance can be extended. People grew up playing games like pokemon and are used to moving characters around and engaging with datapackets in this way. And it fits the keep nouns weird thing well.
how_its_made:
I gave extra care to make it look like a retro game. There were tons of other features I wanted to build, but I wanted to challenge myself this year as a solo hacker.
- React for the site,
- RPG Maker for the game engine,
- WalletConnect for Sign-in,
- Quicknode for RPC, 
- Linea, Mantle, Scroll, Celo, Base, Goerli, and Arbitrum for blockchains
- Wagmi and Ethers.js for libs/packages
